==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Using self induced sleep paralysis, I attained lucidity. I pulled an alligator man barbarian through a portal for interrogation. He led me to their leader (a human woman with light brown skin, a curly orange afro, and a long yellow dress). Her greed and beauty is what turned the once peaceful alligator men into barbarians.
